## 重命名第6-31列（26个维度）

```{r}
ng_q_names <- c("rating of depression", "interoceptive", "internally focused", "externally focused",
                 "self focused", "other focused", "positive", "negative", "problem solving", "guilt",
                 "concern", "anger", "disgust", "fear", "sadness", "surprise", "happiness", "liking",
                 "pleasure", "self-abasement", "disappointment", "reflection", "past", "future",
                 "present", "rumination")

colnames(Gender_alldata)[6:31] <- ng_q_names
colnames(Group_alldata)[6:31] <- ng_q_names
```

## 定义目标维度（ICC>=0.5，剔除rating of depression / self-abasement / reflection）与目标Rater

```{r}
dims_23 <- c("interoceptive", "internally focused", "externally focused", "self focused", "other focused",
             "positive", "negative", "problem solving", "guilt", "concern", "anger", "disgust", "fear",
             "sadness", "surprise", "happiness", "liking", "pleasure", "disappointment", "past", "future",
             "present", "rumination")

target_raters <- c("Qwen-3.5-27B", "Gemini-3.5-Flash", "Claude-Sonnet4.6", "GPT-5.4",
                    "Human", "GLM-5.1", "Deepseek-V4-Pro")
```

原始数据里 Rater 列实际有13个取值（还包含 Deepseek-V3.2 / GPT-4omini / DeepSeek-V3 / GPT-5mini / Gemini-3.1-Pro-Preview / Gemini-3.5-Flash 等未使用的模型版本），先筛掉不需要的：

```{r}
Gender_alldata <- Gender_alldata %>% filter(Rater %in% target_raters)
Group_alldata  <- Group_alldata  %>% filter(Rater %in% target_raters)
```

## 合并性别信息

`Gender_alldata` 本身没有 Gender 列，需要用 Sub_ID 从 `Gender_ID`（即 HC_Gender.xlsx）里把 Gender 关联进来（两边 Sub_ID 可完全精确匹配，282个被试全部对上）：

```{r}
Gender_alldata <- Gender_alldata %>%
  left_join(Gender_ID %>% select(Sub_ID, Gender), by = "Sub_ID")

# 检查有没有没匹配上性别的被试（应为0行）
Gender_alldata %>% filter(is.na(Gender)) %>% distinct(Sub_ID)
```

## 片段水平合成复合评分：Human（已是3人均分） vs LLM_mean（6个选定模型在每个思维片段上的均分）

`Rater=="Human"` 这一行在源数据里已经是3位人类评分者在该思维片段上的均分，可以直接使用；LLM这边要对齐同样的逻辑：在**每个 Participant_ID（思维片段）**上，把6个选定模型的评分取均值，得到一个和 Human 同层级的 "LLM_mean" 片段评分，这样两条线在往上聚合到被试之前，处理路径是完全对称的：

```{r}
llm_raters <- setdiff(target_raters, "Human")

human_segment <- Gender_alldata %>%
  filter(Rater == "Human") %>%
  select(Participant_ID, Sub_ID, Gender, all_of(dims_23)) %>%
  mutate(Rater = "Human")

llm_segment <- Gender_alldata %>%
  filter(Rater %in% llm_raters) %>%
  group_by(Participant_ID, Sub_ID, Gender) %>%
  summarise(across(all_of(dims_23), ~mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE)), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(Rater = "LLM_mean")

Gender_segment_composite <- bind_rows(human_segment, llm_segment)

# 应为 (思维片段总数) x 2（Human / LLM_mean）
dim(Gender_segment_composite)
table(Gender_segment_composite$Rater)
```

## 被试水平聚合：在片段层面合成好的复合评分基础上，对每人的所有思维片段取均值

## 每个被试的思维片段数不同，直接拿片段当分析单位会违反独立性假设，所以分析单位要落到被试层面。这一步在 `Gender_segment_composite` 之上、按 `Sub_ID x Rater` 分组对所有片段取均值，Human 和 LLM_mean 走的是同一套聚合逻辑：

```{r}
Gender_composite <- Gender_segment_composite %>%
  group_by(Sub_ID, Gender, Rater) %>%
  summarise(across(all_of(dims_23), ~mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE)), .groups = "drop")

# 应为 282个被试 x 2（Human / LLM_mean） = 564 行
dim(Gender_composite)
table(Gender_composite$Rater, Gender_composite$Gender)
```

## 正态性检验：按 Rater（Human / LLM_mean）x Gender 分组，对23个维度分别检验

组间比较（男 vs 女）关心的是每组内的正态性，而不是不分组的整体正态性，所以要按 Gender 分组后对23个维度分别做 Shapiro-Wilk 检验，Human 和 LLM_mean 分开做。同时报偏度（skewness）和峰度（kurtosis）作为补充描述。

已经确定：不管这里检验结果如何，后续男女组间比较统一用 Mann-Whitney U（非参数），所以这里的 Shapiro-Wilk 结果只写进方法/结果部分做支持性说明，不用来逐维度切换检验方法。

```{r}
normality_check <- function(data, dims, group_var = "Gender") {
  map_dfr(dims, function(v) {
    data %>%
      group_by(.data[[group_var]]) %>%
      summarise(
        variable = v,
        n = sum(!is.na(.data[[v]])),
        skewness = psych::skew(.data[[v]], na.rm = TRUE),
        kurtosis = psych::kurtosi(.data[[v]], na.rm = TRUE),
        shapiro_W = shapiro.test(.data[[v]])$statistic,
        shapiro_p = shapiro.test(.data[[v]])$p.value,
        .groups = "drop"
      )
  })
}

normality_results <- Gender_composite %>%
  group_by(Rater) %>%
  group_modify(~ normality_check(.x, dims_23)) %>%
  ungroup()

normality_results %>% arrange(Rater, shapiro_p)

# 快速看一下每条线（Human / LLM_mean）里有多少"维度x组"组合不满足正态（p<.05）
normality_results %>%
  group_by(Rater) %>%
  summarise(n_tests = n(), n_nonnormal = sum(shapiro_p < .05), .groups = "drop")
```

把正态性检验结果存成 xlsx：

```{r}
write_xlsx(normality_results,
           "D:/2025THU/SELF_OTHER/LLMRating_Task/draft/Group_analysis/0723normality_results.xlsx")
```

## Mann-Whitney U 检验：Male vs Female，23个维度 x Human/LLM_mean，FDR校正

对 `Gender_composite` 里的每个 Rater（Human / LLM_mean），23个维度分别做 Mann-Whitney U 检验，再在每个 Rater 内部对23个p值做 Benjamini-Hochberg FDR 校正。R的`wilcox.test()`返回的统计量叫"W"，对两独立样本检验来说数值上就是Mann-Whitney U，这里直接命名成U；Z是从p值反推的（R没有直接给），r = Z/√N（Rosenthal公式，常见论文报告Mann-Whitney U效应量用的就是这个）：

```{r}
mwu_results <- Gender_composite %>%
  group_by(Rater) %>%
  group_modify(~ {
    n_by_group <- table(.x$Gender)
    grp_levels <- names(n_by_group)
    n1 <- as.numeric(n_by_group[1])
    n2 <- as.numeric(n_by_group[2])
    N  <- n1 + n2

    map_dfr(dims_23, function(v) {
      x <- .x[[v]][.x$Gender == grp_levels[1]]
      y <- .x[[v]][.x$Gender == grp_levels[2]]

      test <- wilcox.test(x, y)
      U <- unname(test$statistic)
      p <- test$p.value

      # 直接按秩和检验的正态近似公式算Z（带连续性校正+并列秩校正，跟R内部算p值用的是同一套公式），
      # 不再从p值反推——效应极端时p会下溢成精确的0，qnorm(1-0/2)=Inf，导致Z和r变成Inf
      ranks <- rank(c(x, y))
      mu <- n1 * n2 / 2
      ties <- table(ranks)
      sigma <- sqrt((n1 * n2 / 12) * ((N + 1) - sum(ties^3 - ties) / (N * (N - 1))))
      correction <- sign(U - mu) * 0.5
      Z <- (U - mu - correction) / sigma
      r <- Z / sqrt(N)

      tibble(variable = v, n1 = n1, n2 = n2, N = N, U = U, Z = Z, p = p, r = r)
    })
  }) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(Rater) %>%
  mutate(q = p.adjust(p, method = "fdr")) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(sig_label = case_when(
    q < .001 ~ "***",
    q < .01  ~ "**",
    q < .05  ~ "*",
    TRUE     ~ "n.s."
  ))

mwu_results %>% arrange(Rater, q)
```

补上每组的描述统计（Mean/SD/Median/IQR），按 Rater x variable 拼回 `mwu_results`：

```{r}
gender_desc <- Gender_composite %>%
  group_by(Rater, Gender) %>%
  summarise(across(all_of(dims_23),
                    list(mean = ~mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE),
                         sd = ~sd(.x, na.rm = TRUE),
                         median = ~median(.x, na.rm = TRUE),
                         IQR = ~IQR(.x, na.rm = TRUE)),
                    .names = "{.fn}__{.col}"),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_longer(-c(Rater, Gender), names_to = c("stat", "variable"), names_sep = "__", values_to = "value") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = c(Gender, stat), values_from = value, names_glue = "{Gender}_{stat}")

mwu_results <- mwu_results %>%
  left_join(gender_desc, by = c("Rater", "variable")) %>%
  relocate(starts_with("female_"), starts_with("male_"), .after = variable) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~round(.x, 3)))

mwu_results %>% arrange(Rater, q)

# write_xlsx(mwu_results,
#            "D:/2025THU/SELF_OTHER/LLMRating_Task/draft/Group_analysis/0723mwu_results.xlsx")
```

## 雷达图：Male vs Female 各维度均分（不标注显著性，用 plotthis::RadarPlot 画，标尺固定0-3-6-9）

先算出每个 Rater x Gender 在23个维度上的均分（长表，正好是 `RadarPlot` 需要的输入形状：一行一个 x-group-facet 组合）：

```{r}
group_means <- Gender_composite %>%
  group_by(Rater, Gender) %>%
  summarise(across(all_of(dims_23), ~mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE)), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = all_of(dims_23), names_to = "variable", values_to = "mean_score")
```

改用 `plotthis` 包的 `RadarPlot()`（不在CRAN上，需要 `remotes::install_github("pwwang/plotthis")`）。这里 `y` 直接给已经算好的 `mean_score`（不是像你参考代码里 `y = NULL` 那样让函数自己去数频数），`group_by = "Gender"` 控制两条线。Human / LLM_mean 不再用 `facet_by` 拼进同一张图，改用 `split_by = "Rater"` + `combine = FALSE`，这样返回的是一个按Rater命名的列表（`list(Human = ..., LLM_mean = ...)`），两张图各自独立、分开显示；`title = function(x) x` 让每张图自动用对应的Rater名字（Human / LLM_mean）当标题，并在 `theme_args` 里加粗：

```{r, fig.width=7, fig.height=6.5}
library(plotthis)

dims_set1 <- c("interoceptive", "internally focused", "externally focused", "self focused",
               "other focused", "positive", "negative", "problem solving", "past", "future", "present")

dims_set2 <- c("guilt", "concern", "anger", "disgust", "fear", "sadness", "surprise",
               "happiness", "liking", "pleasure", "disappointment", "rumination")

radar_data_set1 <- group_means %>%
  filter(variable %in% dims_set1) %>%
  mutate(variable = factor(str_to_sentence(variable), levels = str_to_sentence(dims_set1)))

radar_data_set2 <- group_means %>%
  filter(variable %in% dims_set2) %>%
  mutate(variable = factor(str_to_sentence(variable), levels = str_to_sentence(dims_set2)))

# 图例key保留"线+点"组合样式，去掉边框/背景/标题，图例放到底部、字体加粗；
# plot.margin 加大，给雷达图外圈的维度标签多留一点空间（RadarPlot没有单独的"标签偏移量"参数，
# 只能靠加大画布边距来实现，如果效果还不够明显，可能需要另外查 RadarPlotAtomic 有没有更细的控制项）
style_radar_legend <- function(p) {
  p +
    guides(colour = guide_legend(override.aes = list(linetype = 1, linewidth = 1.2))) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "bottom",
      legend.background = element_blank(),
      legend.key = element_blank(),
      legend.title = element_blank(),
      legend.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
      plot.margin = margin(20, 20, 20, 20)
    )
}

Radar_list_set1 <- RadarPlot(
  radar_data_set1,
  x = "variable",
  group_by = "Gender",
  y = "mean_score",
  scale_y = "none",
  y_min = 0,
  y_max = 9,
  y_nbreaks = 4,        # 0 / 3 / 6 / 9 四条刻度线
  split_by = "Rater",
  combine = FALSE,
  fill = FALSE,
  alpha = 0.4,
  linewidth = 1,
  pt_size = 2,
  max_charwidth = 20,
  theme_args = list(
    axis.text.x = element_text(face = "bold"),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5)
  ),
  palcolor = c(female = "#9083AA", male = "#30ad41a9"),
  aspect.ratio = 1,
  legend.position = "bottom",
  title = function(x) x
)

Radar_list_set2 <- RadarPlot(
  radar_data_set2,
  x = "variable",
  group_by = "Gender",
  y = "mean_score",
  scale_y = "none",
  y_min = 0,
  y_max = 4,
  y_nbreaks = 5,        # 0 / 1 / 2 / 3 / 4 五条刻度线
  split_by = "Rater",
  combine = FALSE,
  fill = FALSE,
  alpha = 0.4,
  linewidth = 1,
  pt_size = 2,
  max_charwidth = 20,
  theme_args = list(
    axis.text.x = element_text(face = "bold"),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5)
  ),
  palcolor = c(female = "#9083AA", male = "#30ad41a9"),
  aspect.ratio = 1,
  legend.position = "bottom",
  title = function(x) x
)

Radar_list_set1 <- lapply(Radar_list_set1, style_radar_legend)
Radar_list_set2 <- lapply(Radar_list_set2, style_radar_legend)

Radar_list_set1$Human
Radar_list_set1$LLM_mean
Radar_list_set2$Human
Radar_list_set2$LLM_mean
```

# Group组别（HC vs MDD）分析

跟 Gender 那条线用同一套逻辑，但数据源换成 `Group_alldata`（sub_group_alldata.xlsx，178人，91HC+87MDD，Group列自带、不用再merge）和 `Group_ID`（MDD_HC_ID.xlsx，年龄/性别信息用）。`Group_alldata` 在最前面已经跟着 `Gender_alldata` 一起做过列名重命名和Rater筛选了，这里直接复用。

## 片段水平合成复合评分：Human（3人均分） vs LLM_mean（6模型均分）

```{r}
human_segment_grp <- Group_alldata %>%
  filter(Rater == "Human") %>%
  select(Participant_ID, Sub_ID, Group, all_of(dims_23)) %>%
  mutate(Rater = "Human")

llm_segment_grp <- Group_alldata %>%
  filter(Rater %in% llm_raters) %>%
  group_by(Participant_ID, Sub_ID, Group) %>%
  summarise(across(all_of(dims_23), ~mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE)), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(Rater = "LLM_mean")

Group_segment_composite <- bind_rows(human_segment_grp, llm_segment_grp)

dim(Group_segment_composite)
table(Group_segment_composite$Rater)
```

## 被试水平聚合

```{r}
Group_composite <- Group_segment_composite %>%
  group_by(Sub_ID, Group, Rater) %>%
  summarise(across(all_of(dims_23), ~mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE)), .groups = "drop")

# 应为 178个被试 x 2（Human / LLM_mean） = 356 行
dim(Group_composite)
table(Group_composite$Rater, Group_composite$Group)
```

## 正态性检验：按 Rater x Group 分组，23个维度分别检验

复用前面 Gender 分析里定义好的 `normality_check()` 函数，group_var 换成 "Group"：

```{r}
group_normality_results <- Group_composite %>%
  group_by(Rater) %>%
  group_modify(~ normality_check(.x, dims_23, group_var = "Group")) %>%
  ungroup()

group_normality_results %>% arrange(Rater, shapiro_p)

group_normality_results %>%
  group_by(Rater) %>%
  summarise(n_tests = n(), n_nonnormal = sum(shapiro_p < .05), .groups = "drop")

```

## Mann-Whitney U 检验：HC vs MDD，23个维度 x Human/LLM_mean，FDR校正

跟 Gender 那边一样，统一用非参数检验，不因为正态性检验结果逐维度切换方法；同样加上 U（=W）、Z、r = Z/√N。Z直接按秩和检验的正态近似公式算（不从p值反推），避免效应极端、p下溢成0时Z变成Inf：

```{r}
group_mwu_results <- Group_composite %>%
  group_by(Rater) %>%
  group_modify(~ {
    n_by_group <- table(.x$Group)
    grp_levels <- names(n_by_group)
    n1 <- as.numeric(n_by_group[1])
    n2 <- as.numeric(n_by_group[2])
    N  <- n1 + n2

    map_dfr(dims_23, function(v) {
      x <- .x[[v]][.x$Group == grp_levels[1]]
      y <- .x[[v]][.x$Group == grp_levels[2]]

      test <- wilcox.test(x, y)
      U <- unname(test$statistic)
      p <- test$p.value

      ranks <- rank(c(x, y))
      mu <- n1 * n2 / 2
      ties <- table(ranks)
      sigma <- sqrt((n1 * n2 / 12) * ((N + 1) - sum(ties^3 - ties) / (N * (N - 1))))
      correction <- sign(U - mu) * 0.5
      Z <- (U - mu - correction) / sigma
      r <- Z / sqrt(N)
      tibble(variable = v, n1 = n1, n2 = n2, N = N, U = U, Z = Z, p = p, r = r)
    })
  }) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(Rater) %>%
  mutate(q = p.adjust(p, method = "fdr")) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(sig_label = case_when(
    q < .001 ~ "***",
    q < .01  ~ "**",
    q < .05  ~ "*",
    TRUE     ~ "n.s."
  ))

group_mwu_results %>% arrange(Rater, q)
```

补上每组的描述统计（Mean/SD/Median/IQR），按 Rater x variable 拼回 `group_mwu_results`：

```{r}
group_desc <- Group_composite %>%
  group_by(Rater, Group) %>%
  summarise(across(all_of(dims_23),
                    list(mean = ~mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE),
                         sd = ~sd(.x, na.rm = TRUE),
                         median = ~median(.x, na.rm = TRUE),
                         IQR = ~IQR(.x, na.rm = TRUE)),
                    .names = "{.fn}__{.col}"),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_longer(-c(Rater, Group), names_to = c("stat", "variable"), names_sep = "__", values_to = "value") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = c(Group, stat), values_from = value, names_glue = "{Group}_{stat}")

group_mwu_results <- group_mwu_results %>%
  left_join(group_desc, by = c("Rater", "variable")) %>%
  relocate(starts_with("HC_"), starts_with("MDD_"), .after = variable) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~round(.x, 3)))

group_mwu_results %>% arrange(Rater, q)

# write_xlsx(group_mwu_results,
#            "D:/2025THU/SELF_OTHER/LLMRating_Task/draft/Group_analysis/0723group_mwu_results.xlsx")
```

## 雷达图：HC vs MDD 各维度均分（plotthis::RadarPlot，标尺固定0-3-6-9）

配色换一对新的（HC蓝`#2a78d6`、MDD橙`#eb6834`），跟Gender那边的紫/绿区分开，一眼就能看出是不同的比较维度。其余参数（`scale_y="none"`、`split_by="Rater"`+`combine=FALSE`分开显示、`max_charwidth`、加粗、图例样式）都跟Gender部分一致，直接复用 `style_radar_legend()`：

```{r, fig.width=7, fig.height=6.5}
group_means_grp <- Group_composite %>%
```

# 人口学描述性统计 + 年龄差异检验（Gender组 与 Group组）

## Gender组（HC内部 Female vs Male）：来自 `Gender_ID`，年龄数据本身很干净（282人，无缺失）

```{r}
# N_text：每组下思维片段（text）的个数，text的id是 Participant_ID，按它去重计数
n_text_gender <- Gender_alldata %>%
  distinct(Participant_ID, Gender) %>%
  count(Gender, name = "N_text")

gender_age_desc <- Gender_ID %>%
  group_by(Gender) %>%
  summarise(N_sub = n(),
            age_mean = mean(Age, na.rm = TRUE),
            age_sd = sd(Age, na.rm = TRUE),
            age_min = min(Age, na.rm = TRUE),
            age_max = max(Age, na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  left_join(n_text_gender, by = "Gender") %>%
  relocate(N_text, .after = N_sub) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~round(.x, 3)))

gender_age_desc

shapiro.test(Gender_ID$Age[Gender_ID$Gender == "female"])
shapiro.test(Gender_ID$Age[Gender_ID$Gender == "male"])

# 年龄是单个连续变量、样本量较大（151/131），依CLT用t检验（Welch，不假设方差齐性，t.test()默认就是这个）
gender_age_ttest <- t.test(Age ~ Gender, data = Gender_ID)
gender_age_ttest
```

## Group组（HC vs MDD）：来自 `Group_ID`，注意有1人年龄是"/"（缺失），先清洗

```{r}
Group_ID <- Group_ID %>%
  mutate(Age = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(Age)))

# 缺失年龄的被试
Group_ID %>% filter(is.na(Age))

# N_text：Group_alldata（HC+MDD都在里面）按 Participant_ID 去重计数
n_text_group <- Group_alldata %>%
  distinct(Participant_ID, Group) %>%
  count(Group, name = "N_text")

# N_sub 用全组人数（91/87），年龄相关统计单独只从有效年龄的子集里算（MDD实际是86人参与）
group_n_sub <- Group_ID %>%
  group_by(Group) %>%
  summarise(N_sub = n(), .groups = "drop")

group_age_stats <- Group_ID %>%
  filter(!is.na(Age)) %>%
  group_by(Group) %>%
  summarise(age_mean = mean(Age),
            age_sd = sd(Age),
            age_min = min(Age),
            age_max = max(Age),
            .groups = "drop")

group_age_desc <- group_n_sub %>%
  left_join(group_age_stats, by = "Group") %>%
  left_join(n_text_group, by = "Group") %>%
  relocate(N_text, .after = N_sub) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~round(.x, 3)))

group_age_desc

shapiro.test(Group_ID$Age[Group_ID$Group == "HC"])
shapiro.test(Group_ID$Age[Group_ID$Group == "MDD"])

# 同样换成t检验（Welch）
group_age_ttest <- t.test(Age ~ Group, data = Group_ID)
group_age_ttest
```

## 附加：HC/MDD 两组的性别比例是否均衡（人口学表格常规项，非必须，供参考）

```{r}
sex_by_group <- table(Group_ID$Sex, Group_ID$Group)
sex_by_group

chisq.test(sex_by_group)
```
